title: Popescu lifting data smooth at every prime
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-popescu-smooth-lift-modulo-eight, there exist a finitely presented R-algebra D, a map δ : D → Λ, a compatible map A/π⁴A → D/π⁴D, and IsSmoothAtPrime R q for every prime q of D.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-smooth-quotient-factor] with ρ = π⁴. Since (π⁴)² = π⁸, its hypothesis is exactly the assumed ind-property. Obtain a smooth R/(π⁸)-algebra C and maps β and j with the factorization equality modulo π⁸.

Positive powers of π and its image in Λ remain nonzerodivisors. The annihilator of the principal ideal generated by a nonzerodivisor x is zero: an element annihilating the ideal annihilates x itself, and injectivity of multiplication by x makes that element zero. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lifting] with π⁴ to obtain D, δ, its quotient maps, finite presentation, and the smoothness clauses.

For a prime q of D not containing the image of π⁴, use clause (b) of Popescu lifting. If it contains that image, it contains its generated ideal and therefore is the inverse image of a prime of D/(π⁴), by the prime-spectrum quotient correspondence. The inverse image of that prime in C is smooth: localize the globally smooth C at 1 and use [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-principal-localization]. Clause (c) of Popescu lifting then makes D smooth at q.

The R-algebra map f = c ∘ β from A into D/(π⁴) kills (algebraMap R A π)⁴ because its image is the class of (algebraMap R D π)⁴. Factor f through A/(π⁴) by Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ. For representatives a and d with f(a) equal to the class of d, apply the quotient map ψ: its compatibility with c and j, the factorization equality for jβ, and the reduction identity give ψ(f(a)) equal to the class of α(a). Compatibility of ψ with δ gives ψ(d mod π⁴) equal to the class of δ(d). Transitivity proves the stated compatibility.

theorem exists_popescu_smooth_lift_data
    (R : Type u) (Λ : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra R Λ]
    [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (A : Type (max u v)) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A]
    (α : A →ₐ[R] Λ) (π : R) (hπ : π ∈ R⁰) (hπΛ : algebraMap R Λ π ∈ Λ⁰)
    (hmod : ObjectProperty.ind.{max u v}
      (fun B : CommAlgCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 8}) ↦
        Algebra.Smooth (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 8}) B)
      (CommAlgCat.of (R ⧸ Ideal.span {π ^ 8})
        (Λ ⧸ (Ideal.span {π ^ 8}).map (algebraMap R Λ)))) :
    ∃ (D : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : Algebra R D)
      (_ : Algebra.FinitePresentation R D) (δ : D →ₐ[R] Λ),
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum D, Algebra.IsSmoothAtPrime R q) ∧
      ∃ φ : (A ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R A π) ^ 4}) →ₐ[R]
        (D ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R D π) ^ 4}),
        ∀ (a : A) (d : D),
          φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ d →
          Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (α a) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (δ d)
